definitions.explanation: To buy again something one has sold or lost: a house, a family heirloom from a pawnshop, a company's own shares, land once sold to others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{戻|もど}す。
⟦{売|う}った→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{買|か}い{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: I bought back the watch I had sold, at a high price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: The company bought back its own shares from the market to support its stock price.

notes:
Made of ⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy) + ⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (to return, put back).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive (〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{戻|もど}す)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{戻|もど}す: to buy back shares
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧／⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{戻|もど}す: to buy back land or a house
- {質|しち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{戻|もど}す: to redeem something from a pawnshop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買|か}い{取|と}る→買い取る：16704_kaitoru⟧: to buy (from someone), to purchase outright
- ⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧: to get back, recover (by any means)
